prompt: The bearded man sitting in the bright bedroom is a lifelike humanoid ROBOT version of himself. Matte pale-grey synthetic skin with fine seam lines along the jaw, temple and neck, a thin metal collar ring at the throat, faintly glowing cool-blue irises, the same beard shape and hairstyle rendered as synthetic fibre, still wearing the same olive-green sweatshirt, sitting in the same room with the same framing. It talks to the camera with calm, slightly too-smooth head movements and blinks with a mechanical shutter. Locked-off static camera, no cut, natural daylight, photoreal, uncanny but calm.
